item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena and her friend Arjun want to measure the length of their classroom so that both of them get the same result. Meena suggests four different ways to measure it.
Which way is suitable as a standard unit for shared measurements?

options.A: Measuring with Meena's handspan, because it is easy to use
options.B: Measuring with Arjun's footstep, because he walks carefully
options.C: Measuring in metres using a metre scale, because the metre is an SI unit
options.D: Measuring with a stick of any length found near the classroom
